definitions.full: H3024. yegiah יְגִעָה noun feminine wearying (late formative, Dr Intr. 455 Siegf NH Gram § 47 b ) כָּשָׂר יְגִעַת הַרְבֵּה וְלַהַג Eccl 12:12 and studying much is a wearying of flesh.
